content.comment_body: Hello [user_name], I've tried your tool and it works very well. However, I also need to log the values of some up/down counters over their entire range (0 to 999,999). Could you assist with this? Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user successfully used a third-party logging tool with [product_name] but noticed a limitation when trying to record up/down counter values for their full range. There is a need for improved data logging, especially to support capturing counter variables at higher values within the current product setup.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the capability to log up/down counter values from 0 to 999,999 directly from the product, without limitations. They hope the logging tool or product will naturally support full-range integer values from counters.
